end.parentNote: Arjun practised converting distances to metres before comparing them and used addition to convert 2 km 75 m into 2075 m. They first compared the visible numbers without matching units, but corrected this later by using 1 km = 1000 m; the mixed-unit ordering still needs more practice. At home, ask Arjun to order three distances by first rewriting each one in metres and saying why the order works.
